gloves_of_astral_sanctuary.text_en: Instant - {t} your hero, destroy this: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you this turn.

go_bananas.text_zh: 说出一张行动牌名。拆开并展示一包Flesh and Blood补充包，将所有具有所选名称的牌置入你的手牌。若补充包中没有具有所选名称的牌，你可以重复此过程。
go_bananas.text_en: Name an action card. Open and reveal a booster pack of Flesh and Blood and put all cards with the chosen name into your hand. If the booster pack does not contain a card with the chosen name, you may repeat this process.

gold.text_zh: 行动——支付2点资源，摧毁此牌：抽一张牌。再动
gold.text_en: Action - {r}{r}, destroy this: Draw a card. Go again

goldkiss_rum.text_zh: 瞬间——横置你的英雄，摧毁此牌：你本回合的下一次行动获得再动。除非你的英雄为海盗，否则本回合你的英雄不能重置。
goldkiss_rum.text_en: Instant - {t} your hero, destroy this: Your next action this turn gets go again. Your hero can't {u} this turn unless they're a Pirate.

goliath_gauntlet.text_zh: 行动——摧毁此牌：你本回合使用的下一张费用为2或更高的攻击行动牌获得+2力量。再动
goliath_gauntlet.text_en: Action - Destroy this: The next attack action card with cost 2 or more you play this turn gets +2{p}. Go again

good_deeds_dont_go_unnoticed.text_zh:
在每位其他英雄的回合开始时，选择其一；该英雄抽一张牌，该英雄获得1点资源，该英雄获得1点生命，或该英雄本回合的下一次攻击获得+1力量。
在你的回合开始时，摧毁此牌。若另一位英雄因此牌抽过牌，你抽一张牌，然后对资源、生命和力量各重复一次。
good_deeds_dont_go_unnoticed.text_en:
At the start of each other hero's turn, choose 1; they draw a card, they gain {r}, they gain 1{h}, or their next attack this turn gains +1{p}.
At the start of your turn, destroy this. If another hero drew a card from this, you draw a card, then repeat for {r}, {h}, and {p}.

gore_belching.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，从你的牌库顶展示牌，直到你展示一张攻击行动牌。若如此做，放逐它，此牌获得-X力量，X为以此方式放逐的牌的力量。否则，此牌获得-7力量。然后洗牌。
gore_belching.text_en: When this attacks, reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal an attack action card. If you do, banish it and this gets -X{p}, where X is the {p} of the card banished this way. Otherwise, this gets -7{p}. Shuffle.

gorganian_tome.text_zh:
传奇
抽X张牌，X为1加上所有坟场中戈尔戈尼安典籍的数量。
再动
gorganian_tome.text_en:
Legendary
Draw X cards, where X is 1 plus the number of Gorganian Tomes in all graveyards.
Go again

grandstand_legplates.text_zh:
看台腿甲的防御等于生命比你高的对手英雄数量。
刃碎
grandstand_legplates.text_en:
Grandstand Legplates' {d} is equal to the number of opposing heroes with greater {h} than you.
Blade Break

gravekeeping.text_zh: 当此牌攻击英雄时，你可以放逐其坟场中的一张牌。
gravekeeping.text_en: When this attacks a hero, you may banish a card from their graveyard.

hack_to_reality.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次攻击获得+2力量。
本回合你下一次命中英雄时，摧毁该英雄拥有的一个费用小于或等于以此方式造成的伤害的非衍生物光环。
再动
hack_to_reality.text_en:
Your next attack this turn gets +2{p}.
The next time you hit a hero this turn, destroy a non-token aura they own with cost less than or equal to the damage dealt this way.
Go again

hand_behind_the_pen.text_zh: 当此牌命中英雄时，将其军械库中的一张牌翻为正面朝上，然后放逐其军械库中的一张非攻击行动牌。
hand_behind_the_pen.text_en: When this hits a hero, turn a card in their arsenal face-up, then banish a non-attack action card from their arsenal.

hard_knuckle.text_zh: 当你使用攻击行动牌时，你可以摧毁此牌。若如此做，该攻击获得+1力量。
hard_knuckle.text_en: When you play an attack action card, you may destroy this. If you do, the attack gets +1{p}.

headliner_helm.text_zh:
头条头盔的防御等于生命比你高的对手英雄数量。
刃碎
headliner_helm.text_en:
Headliner Helm's {d} is equal to the number of opposing heroes with greater {h} than you.
Blade Break

healing_potion.text_zh: 行动——摧毁此牌：获得2点生命。再动
healing_potion.text_en: Action - Destroy this: Gain 2{h}. Go again

heart_of_fyendal.text_zh:
传奇
当你将菲恩达尔之心资源时，若你的生命低于一位对手英雄，获得1点生命。
heart_of_fyendal.text_en:
Legendary
When you pitch Heart of Fyendal, if you have less {h} than an opposing hero, gain 1{h}.

heartened_cross_strap.text_zh: 行动——摧毁此牌：你本回合使用的下一张攻击行动牌的费用减少2点资源。再动
heartened_cross_strap.text_en: Action - Destroy this: The next attack action card you play this turn costs {r}{r} less to play. Go again

helios_mitre.text_zh:
（在起义限制赛制中，牌手可以将一张赫利俄斯法冠加入其卡池。）
瞬间——支付2点资源：防止本回合接下来将由你选择的一个来源对你的英雄造成的1点伤害。在结束阶段开始时摧毁赫利俄斯法冠。
helios_mitre.text_en:
(A player may add a Helio's Mitre to their card pool in an Uprising limited format.)
Instant - {r}{r}: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to your hero this turn by a source of your choice. Destroy Helio's Mitre at the beginning of the end phase.

helm_of_astral_sanctuary.text_zh: 瞬间——横置你的英雄，摧毁此牌：防止本回合接下来将对你造成的1点伤害。
helm_of_astral_sanctuary.text_en: Instant - {t} your hero, destroy this: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you this turn.

helm_of_hindsight.text_zh: 瞬间——支付3点资源，摧毁此牌：将你坟场中的目标攻击行动牌置于牌库顶。
helm_of_hindsight.text_en: Instant - {r}{r}{r}, destroy this: Put target attack action card from your graveyard on top of your deck.

helm_of_safe_haven.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，展示你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为攻击行动牌，将其作为防御牌加入此链环并弃一张牌。
刃碎
helm_of_safe_haven.text_en:
When this defends, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's an attack action card, add it to this chain link as a defending card and discard a card.
Blade Break

helmsmans_peak.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，查看你牌库顶的一张牌。
刃碎
helmsmans_peak.text_en:
When this defends, look at the top card of your deck.
Blade Break

high_current_currency.text_zh: 从对手控制的目标非英雄永久物上移除所有能量指示物。创造等量的金币衍生物。
high_current_currency.text_en: Remove all energy counters from target non-hero permanent an opponent controls. Create that many Gold tokens.

high_striker.text_zh:
本回合你控制的攻击下一次命中时，创造6个铜币衍生物。
再动
high_striker.text_en:
The next time an attack you control hits this turn, create 6 Copper tokens.
Go again

hold_the_line.text_zh: 若攻击英雄本回合抽过两张或更多牌，防止本回合接下来将对你的英雄造成的3点伤害。
hold_the_line.text_en: If the attacking hero has drawn 2 or more cards this turn, prevent the next 3 damage that would be dealt to your hero this turn.

hood_of_second_thoughts.text_zh: 瞬间——摧毁此牌：防止本回合接下来将对你造成的1点伤害。仅当本回合你受到过伤害时才能启动此异能。
hood_of_second_thoughts.text_en: Instant - Destroy this: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you this turn. Activate this only if you've been dealt damage this turn.

hope_merchants_hood.text_zh: 瞬间——摧毁此牌：将你手牌中的任意数量牌洗入你的牌库，然后抽等量的牌。
hope_merchants_hood.text_en: Instant - Destroy this: Shuffle any number of cards from your hand into your deck, then draw that many cards.

humble.text_zh: 当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄失去所有英雄牌异能，直到其下一个回合结束。
humble.text_en: When this hits a hero, they lose all hero card abilities until the end of their next turn.

imperial_edict.text_zh:
传奇
行动——摧毁帝国敕令：说出一张牌名。直到你的下一个回合开始，被说出的牌不能被使用。若你为皇族，改为每位对手展示其手牌，然后你说出一张牌名。再动
imperial_edict.text_en:
Legendary
Action - Destroy Imperial Edict: Name a card. The named card can't be played until the start of your next turn. If you are Royal, instead each opponent reveals their hand, then name a card. Go again

imperial_ledger.text_zh:
传奇
行动——将帝国账本洗入其拥有者的牌库：创造一个铜币衍生物。若你为皇族，改为创造一个金币衍生物。
imperial_ledger.text_en:
Legendary
Action - Shuffle Imperial Ledger into its owner's deck: Create a Copper token. If you are Royal, instead create a Gold token.

imperial_seal_of_command.text_zh:
传奇
行动——摧毁此牌：本回合防御反应牌不能被使用。若你为皇族，本回合你下一次命中英雄时，摧毁其军械库中的所有牌。再动
imperial_seal_of_command.text_en:
Legendary
Action - Destroy this: Defense reaction cards can't be played this turn. If you are Royal, the next time you hit a hero this turn, destroy all cards in their arsenal. Go again

imperial_warhorn.text_zh:
传奇
行动——支付1点资源，摧毁帝国战号角：选择任意数量的英雄。每位英雄选择一个其控制的盟友、光环、物品或地标永久物。摧毁每个以此方式选择的永久物。若你为皇族，改为由你选择这些永久物。
imperial_warhorn.text_en:
Legendary
Action - {r}, destroy Imperial Warhorn: Choose any number of heroes. Each of them chooses an ally, aura, item, or landmark permanent they control. Destroy each permanent chosen this way. If you are Royal, instead you choose the permanents.

inertia.text_zh: 在你的结束阶段开始时，摧毁惰性，然后将你手牌和军械库中的所有牌置于你的牌库底。
inertia.text_en: At the beginning of your end phase, destroy Inertia, then put all cards from your hand and arsenal on the bottom of your deck.

infectious_host.text_zh: 当此牌攻击英雄时，若你控制一个虚弱衍生物，在该英雄的控制下创造一个虚弱衍生物，然后对惰性和血腐疫病各重复一次。
infectious_host.text_en: When this attacks a hero, if you control a Frailty token, create a Frailty token under their control, then repeat for Inertia and Bloodrot Pox.

ironhide_gauntlet.text_zh: 当你用铁皮护手防御时，你可以支付1点资源。若如此做，它获得+2防御，以及“当战斗链关闭时，摧毁铁皮护手。”
ironhide_gauntlet.text_en: When you defend with Ironhide Gauntlet, you may pay {r}. If you do, it gains +2{d} and "When the combat chain closes, destroy Ironhide Gauntlet."

ironhide_helm.text_zh: 当你用铁皮头盔防御时，你可以支付1点资源。若如此做，它获得+2防御，以及“当战斗链关闭时，摧毁铁皮头盔。”
ironhide_helm.text_en: When you defend with Ironhide Helm, you may pay {r}. If you do, it gains +2{d} and "When the combat chain closes, destroy Ironhide Helm."

ironhide_legs.text_zh: 当你用铁皮腿甲防御时，你可以支付1点资源。若如此做，它获得+2防御，以及“当战斗链关闭时，摧毁铁皮腿甲。”
ironhide_legs.text_en: When you defend with Ironhide Legs, you may pay {r}. If you do, it gains +2{d} and "When the combat chain closes, destroy Ironhide Legs."

ironhide_plate.text_zh: 当你用铁皮胸甲防御时，你可以支付1点资源。若如此做，它获得+2防御，并在战斗链关闭时摧毁它。
ironhide_plate.text_en: When you defend with Ironhide Plate, you may pay {r}. If you do, it gains +2{d} and destroy it when the combat chain closes.

jack_be_nimble.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，你可以放逐你坟场中的一张轻灵之道。若如此做，此牌获得+1力量和再动。
当此牌命中英雄时，偷取其控制的一个物品直到此行动阶段结束。
jack_be_nimble.text_en:
When this attacks, you may banish a Nimblism from your graveyard. If you do, this gets +1{p} and go again.
When this hits a hero, steal an item they control until the end of this action phase.

jack_be_quick.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，你可以放逐你坟场中的一张轻灵之道。若如此做，此牌获得+1力量和再动。
当此牌命中英雄时，重置其控制的一个盟友，然后偷取它直到此行动阶段结束。
jack_be_quick.text_en:
When this attacks, you may banish a Nimblism from your graveyard. If you do, this gets +1{p} and go again.
When this hits a hero, {u} an ally they control, then steal it until the end of this action phase.

kick_the_hornets_nest.text_zh: 当对手的效果将此牌从任何区域置入你的坟场时，创造自信、力量、坚韧、活力衍生物各一个。
kick_the_hornets_nest.text_en: When an opponent's effect puts this into your graveyard from anywhere, create a Confidence, Might, Toughness, and Vigor token.

knick_knack_bric_a_brac.text_zh:
作为使用小玩意的额外费用，你可以摧毁你控制的任意数量的铜币、银币和/或金币。
从你的牌库中搜寻一张名称中含有护符、药剂或护身符的牌，将其放入竞技场，然后洗牌。每以此方式摧毁4个铜币、2个银币和/或1个金币，重复此过程。
knick_knack_bric_a_brac.text_en:
As an additional cost to play Knick Knack Bric-a-brac, you may destroy any number of Copper, Silver, and/or Gold you control.
Search your deck for a card with Amulet, Potion, or Talisman in its name, put it into the arena, then shuffle. For each 4 Copper, 2 Silver, and/or 1 Gold destroyed this way, repeat this process.

last_ditch_effort.text_zh: 当你使用最后挣扎时，若你的牌库中没有牌，它获得+4力量和再动。
last_ditch_effort.text_en: When you play Last Ditch Effort, if you have no cards in your deck, it gains +4{p} and go again.

lay_low.text_zh:
若你已被标记，你不能使用此牌。
若防御英雄已被标记，其本回合的下一次攻击获得-1力量。
lay_low.text_en:
If you are marked, you can't play this.
If the defending hero is marked, their next attack this turn gets -1{p}.

lead_the_charge.text_zh:
本回合你下一次使用费用为0或更高的行动牌时，获得1个行动点。
再动
lead_the_charge.text_en:
The next time you play an action card with cost 0 or greater this turn, gain 1 action point.
Go again

life_for_a_life.text_zh:
当此牌被使用时，若你的生命低于一位对手英雄，它获得再动。
当此牌命中时，获得1点生命。
life_for_a_life.text_en:
When this is played, if you have less {h} than an opposing hero, it gets go again.
When this hits, gain 1{h}.

life_of_the_party.text_zh:
你可以弃置或摧毁你控制的一张名为疯狂酿造的牌，而非支付聚会中心人物的费用。若如此做，选择所有模式，否则随机选择其一；
此牌获得“当此牌命中时，获得2点生命。”
此牌获得+2力量。
此牌获得再动。
life_of_the_party.text_en:
You may discard or destroy a card you control named Crazy Brew rather than pay Life of the Party's {r} cost. If you do, choose all modes, otherwise choose 1 at random;

This gets "When this hits, gain life 2{h}."
This gets +2{p}.
This gets go again.

light_fingers.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，若你为盗贼，偷取攻击英雄控制的一个金币衍生物。
刃碎
light_fingers.text_en:
When this defends, if you are a Thief, steal a Gold token the attacking hero controls.
Blade Break

look_tuff.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，它获得-1力量，除非你支付1点资源。
look_tuff.text_en: When this attacks, it gets -1{p} unless you pay {r}.

looking_for_a_scrap.text_zh: 作为使用找碴的额外费用，你可以放逐你坟场中一张力量为1的牌。当你如此做时，此牌获得+1力量和再动。
looking_for_a_scrap.text_en: As an additional cost to play Looking for a Scrap, you may banish a card with 1{p} from your graveyard. When you do, this gains +1{p} and go again.

lunging_press.text_zh: 目标攻击行动牌获得+1力量。

mage_master_boots.text_zh: 行动——支付1点资源，摧毁此牌：你本回合使用的下一张非攻击行动牌获得再动。再动
mage_master_boots.text_en: Action - {r}, destroy this: The next non-attack action card you play this turn gets go again. Go again

memorial_ground.text_zh: 将你坟场中费用为2或更低的目标攻击行动牌置于牌库顶。
memorial_ground.text_en: Put target attack action card with cost 2 or less from your graveyard on top of your deck.

midas_touch.text_zh:
摧毁目标盟友。其操控者创造与其费用等量的金币衍生物。
再动
midas_touch.text_en:
Destroy target ally. Its controller creates Gold tokens equal to its cost.
Go again

might.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，摧毁此牌，然后你本回合的下一次攻击获得+1力量。
might.text_en: At the start of your turn, destroy this, then your next attack this turn gets +1{p}.

minnowism.text_zh:
你本回合使用的下一张基础力量为3或更低的攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
再动
minnowism.text_en:
The next attack action card with 3 or less base {p} you play this turn gains +3{p}.
Go again

mischievous_meeps.text_zh:
当此牌命中英雄时，获得其控制的一张费用为2或更低的物品的控制权。否则，抽一张牌。
再动
mischievous_meeps.text_en:
When this hits a hero, gain control of an item with cost 2 or less they control. Otherwise, draw a card.
Go again

money_or_your_life.text_zh: 当此牌命中英雄时，除非该英雄将其控制的一个金币衍生物给你，否则对其造成2点伤害。若你为盗贼，重复此过程一次。
money_or_your_life.text_en: When this hits a hero, deal 2 damage to them unless they give you a Gold token they control. If you are a Thief, repeat this process once.

money_where_ya_mouth_is.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次攻击获得+3力量，以及“当此牌攻击英雄时，你可以与该英雄下注。胜者创造一个金币衍生物。”
再动
money_where_ya_mouth_is.text_en:
Your next attack this turn gets +3{p} and "When this attacks a hero, you may wager with them. The winner creates a Gold token."
Go again

moon_wish.text_zh:
你可以将手牌中的一张牌置于你的牌库顶，而非支付月光祈愿的费用。
若月光祈愿命中，从你的牌库中搜寻一张名为阳光之吻的牌，展示它，将其置入你的手牌，然后洗牌。
moon_wish.text_en:
You may put a card from your hand on top of your deck rather than pay Moon Wish's {r} cost.
If Moon Wish hits, search your deck for a card named Sun Kiss, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle your deck.

myrkhellir_helm.text_zh:
若你控制一个金币，此牌获得+1防御。
行动——支付2点资源，摧毁此牌：本回合你下一次将从金币衍生物抽一张牌时，改为抽两张牌。再动
淬炼
myrkhellir_helm.text_en:
If you control a Gold, this gets +1{d}.
Action - {r}{r}, destroy this: The next time you would draw a card from a Gold token this turn, instead draw 2 cards. Go again
Temper

nasty_surprise.text_zh: 当对手的效果将此牌从任何区域置入你的坟场时，创造敏捷、力量、活力衍生物各一个。
nasty_surprise.text_en: When an opponent's effect puts this into your graveyard from anywhere, create an Agility, Might, and Vigor token.

nimble_strike.text_zh: 作为使用灵巧打击的额外费用，你可以放逐你坟场中一张名为轻灵之道的牌。若如此做，灵巧打击获得+1力量和再动。
nimble_strike.text_en: As an additional cost to play Nimble Strike, you may banish a card named Nimblism from your graveyard. If you do, Nimble Strike gain +1{p} and go again.

nimblism.text_zh:
你本回合使用的下一张费用为1或更低的攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
再动
nimblism.text_en:

the_weakest_link.text_en: When this hits a hero, look at their hand and choose a card without base {d}. If you do, they discard it and you draw a card.

this_rounds_on_me.text_zh:
每位英雄抽一张牌。
直到你的下一个回合开始，以你为目标的攻击获得-1力量。
再动
this_rounds_on_me.text_en:
Each hero draws a card.
Until the start of your next turn, attacks that target you have -1{p}.
Go again

threadbare_tunic.text_zh: 瞬间——摧毁破旧外衣：获得1点资源。仅当你手牌中没有牌时才能启动此异能。
threadbare_tunic.text_en: Instant - Destroy Threadbare Tunic: Gain {r}. Activate this ability only if you have no cards in hand.

thwart.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，从攻击牌上移除所有+1力量指示物。
thwart.text_en: When this defends, remove all +1{p} counters from the attacking card.

ticket_puncher.text_zh:
验票员的防御等于生命比你高的对手英雄数量。
刃碎
ticket_puncher.text_en:
Ticket Puncher's {d} is equal to the number of opposing heroes with greater {h} than you.
Blade Break

time_flies_when_youre_having_fun.name_en: Time Flies When You're Having Fun
time_flies_when_youre_having_fun.text_zh:
本回合攻击行动牌下一次命中英雄时，你可以摧毁其控制的一个光环。
若此牌是从军械库使用的，本回合你使用的下一张攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
再动
time_flies_when_youre_having_fun.text_en:
The next time an attack action card hits a hero this turn, you may destroy an aura they control.
If this was played from arsenal, the next attack action card you play this turn gets +3{p}.
Go again

time_skippers.text_zh: 行动——支付3点资源，摧毁此牌：获得2个行动点。
time_skippers.text_en: Action - {r}{r}{r}, destroy this: Gain 2 action points.

timesnap_potion.text_zh: 行动——摧毁此牌：获得2个行动点。
timesnap_potion.text_en: Action - Destroy this: Gain 2 action points.

tip_off.text_zh: 瞬间——弃掉此牌：标记目标对手英雄。
tip_off.text_en: Instant - Discard this: Mark target opposing hero.

tit_for_tat.text_zh:
横置目标英雄，重置另一个目标英雄。
再动
tit_for_tat.text_en:
{t} target hero. {u} another target hero.
Go again

toby_jugs.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，你可以支付1点资源。若如此做，本回合它获得+2防御。
刃碎
toby_jugs.text_en:
When this defends, you may pay {r}. If you do, it gets +2{d} this turn.
Blade Break

tome_of_fyendal.text_zh:
抽2张牌。
若菲恩达尔之书是从军械库使用的，为你手牌中的每张牌获得1点生命。
tome_of_fyendal.text_en:
Draw 2 cards.
If Tome of Fyendal is played from arsenal, gain 1{h} for each card in your hand.

tongue_tied.text_zh: 当此牌命中英雄时，将其军械库中的一张牌翻为正面朝上，然后放逐其军械库中的一张瞬间牌。
tongue_tied.text_en: When this hits a hero, turn a card in their arsenal face-up, then banish an instant card from their arsenal.

toughness.text_zh: 在你的对手的回合开始时，摧毁此牌，然后本回合你用于防御的下一张行动牌在此链环中获得+1防御。
toughness.text_en: At the start of your opponent's turn, destroy this, then the next action card you defend with this turn gets +1{d} this chain link.

trade_in.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，你可以弃一张牌。若如此做，抽一张牌。
若此牌是从军械库使用的，它获得再动。
trade_in.text_en:
When this attacks, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
If this was played from arsenal, it gains go again.

tremor_of_i_arathael.text_zh: 若本回合有牌被置入你的放逐区，伊阿拉塞尔的震颤获得+2力量。
tremor_of_i_arathael.text_en: If a card has been put into your banished zone this turn, Tremor of íArathael gains +2{p}.

tremor_of_iarathael.text_zh: 若本回合有一张牌被置入你的放逐区，伊阿拉塞尔之震动获得+2力量。
tremor_of_iarathael.text_en: If a card has been put into your banished zone this turn, Tremor of íArathael gains +2{p}.

trot_along.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次基础力量为3或更低的攻击获得再动。
再动
trot_along.text_en:
Your next attack with 3 or less base {p} this turn gets go again.
Go again

truce.text_zh:
当此牌进入竞技场时，选择一位对手。
在其结束阶段开始时，摧毁此牌，你们各获得3点生命。
当你或你控制的一张牌成为其控制的一个攻击的目标时，摧毁此牌并抽一张牌。
truce.text_en:
When this enters the arena, choose an opponent.
At the beginning of their end phase, destroy this and you each gain 3{h}.
When you or a card you control is the target of an attack they control, destroy this and draw a card.

unflinching_foothold.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁此牌：目标攻击失去且不能获得支配。
战痕
unflinching_foothold.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this: Target attack loses and can't gain dominate.
Battleworn

unmovable.text_zh: 若此牌是从军械库使用的，它获得+1防御。
unmovable.text_en: If this was played from arsenal, it gets +1{d}.

unwavering_resolve.text_zh:
若你的牌库中没有牌，此牌获得+4力量。
若此牌被3张或更多牌防御，它获得再动。
unwavering_resolve.text_en:
If you have no cards in your deck, this gets +4{p}.
If this is defended by 3 or more cards, it gets go again.

unyielding_grip.text_zh:
若你手牌中没有牌，此牌获得+3防御。
刃碎
unyielding_grip.text_en:
If you have no cards in your hand, this gets +3{d}.
Blade Break

vambrace_of_determination.text_zh:
每回合一次攻击反应——支付1点资源：本回合下一个防止伤害的防止效果少防止1点伤害。
当此牌防御时，你可以支付1点资源。若如此做，它获得+1防御和刃碎。
vambrace_of_determination.text_en:
Once per Turn Attack Reaction - {r}: The next prevention effect that prevents {p} damage this turn, prevents 1 less of that damage.
When this defends, you may pay {r}. If you do, it gains +1{d} and blade break.

venomback_fabric.text_zh:
传奇
装备结痂皮革。若你没有，此牌无效。
venomback_fabric.text_en:
Legendary
Equip Scabskin Leathers. If you don't, negate this.

vest_of_the_first_fist.text_zh: 当你控制的攻击行动牌命中时，你可以摧毁第一拳背心。若如此做，获得2点资源。
vest_of_the_first_fist.text_en: When an attack action card you control hits, you may destroy Vest of the First Fist. If you do, gain {r}{r}.

vigilant_dodgers.text_zh: 瞬间——摧毁此牌：防止本回合接下来将对你造成的1点伤害。仅当本回合有武器攻击过时才能启动此异能。
vigilant_dodgers.text_en: Instant - Destroy this: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you this turn. Activate this only if a weapon has attacked this turn.

vigor.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，摧毁此牌，然后获得1点资源。
vigor.text_en: At the start of your turn, destroy this, then gain {r}.

vigor_rush.text_zh: 若你本回合使用过一张“非攻击”行动牌，活力奔涌获得再动。
vigor_rush.text_en: If you have played a 'non-attack' action card this turn, Vigor Rush gains go again.

vipox.text_zh: 当毒痘命中英雄时，该英雄失去与其手牌数量等量的生命。
vipox.text_en: When Vipox hits a hero, they lose {h} equal to the number of cards in their hand.

visit_the_blacksmith.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次剑攻击获得+1力量。
再动
visit_the_blacksmith.text_en:
Your next sword attack this turn gains +1{p}.
Go again

wage_gold.text_zh:
通用
当此牌攻击英雄时，你可以与该英雄以金币衍生物下注。
wage_gold.text_en:
Universal
When this attacks a hero, you may wager a Gold token with them.

walk_the_plank.text_zh: 当此牌命中海盗英雄时，横置该英雄或其控制的一个盟友。
walk_the_plank.text_en: When this hits a Pirate hero, {t} them or an ally they control.

warmongers_diplomacy.text_zh:
从你左边的英雄开始，每位英雄选择战争或和平。
若他们选择战争，其下一个回合期间他们只能使用或启动武器和攻击行动。
若他们选择和平，其下一个回合期间他们只能使用或启动非武器非攻击行动。
warmongers_diplomacy.text_en:
Starting with the hero to your left, each hero chooses war or peace.
If they choose war, the only actions they may play or activate during their next turn are weapon and attack actions.
If they choose peace, the only actions they may play or activate during their next turn are non-weapon non-attack actions.

warmongers_recital.text_zh:
你本回合使用的下一张攻击行动牌获得+3力量，以及“当此牌命中时，将其置于其拥有者的牌库底。”
再动
warmongers_recital.text_en:
The next attack action card you play this turn gains +3{p} and "When this hits, put it on the bottom of its owner's deck."
Go again

water_the_seeds.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，你本战斗链中下一次基础力量为1或更低的攻击获得+1力量。
再动
water_the_seeds.text_en:
When this attacks, your next attack this combat chain with 1 or less base {p} gets +1{p}.
Go again

wounded_bull.text_zh: 当你使用此牌时，若你的生命低于一位对手英雄，此牌获得+1力量。
wounded_bull.text_en: When you play this, if you have less {h} than an opposing hero, this gains +1{p}.

wreck_havoc.text_zh:
此链环不能使用防御反应牌。
当此牌命中英雄时，你可以将其军械库中的一张牌翻为正面朝上，然后摧毁其军械库中的一张防御反应牌。
wreck_havoc.text_en:
Defense reactions can't be played to this chain link.
When this hits a hero, you may turn a card in their arsenal face up, then destroy a defense reaction in their arsenal.

yinti_yanti.text_zh:
当因提扬提正在攻击且你控制一个光环时，它获得+1力量。
当因提扬提正在防御且你控制一个光环时，它获得+1防御。
yinti_yanti.text_en:
While Yinti Yanti is attacking and you control an aura, it has +1{p}.
While Yinti Yanti is defending and you control an aura, it has +1{d}.

zealous_belting.text_zh: 当你资源区中有一张力量大于狂热皮带基础力量的牌时，狂热皮带获得再动。
zealous_belting.text_en: While there is a card in your pitch zone with {p} greater than Zealous Belting's base {p}, Zealous Belting has go again.
